messages.subject: Error Running in Linux
parts:
I am getting the following error with my script which didnt happen when running on windows:

If program is crashing, try run.gads = 2.

downloading DEM via package elevatr
 Accessing raster elevation [=========================] 100%
Mosaicing & Projecting
Note: Elevation units are in meters.
extracting weather data locally from /mnt/d/PRR/ERA5/PT
Distance weighting applied.
Diurnal temperature range correction applied.
Distance weighting applied.
computing radiation and elevation effects with package microclima
Downscaling radiation and wind speed
Error in dtm3[101:(x + 100), 101:(y + 100)] <- dtm :
  incorrect number of subscripts on matrix


This is the script i am currently running:

library(NicheMapR)
library(ecmwfr)
library(mcera5)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(tidync)
library(rgdal)
library(raster)
run.gads=2
dstart <- "01/01/1979"
dfinish <- "31/12/1979"

loc<-c(-7.5494,38.3985)
micro<-micro_era5(loc = loc, dstart = dstart, dfinish = dfinish, spatial = '/mnt/d/PRR/ERA5/PT', runshade = 0, Usrhyt =2)

I am not sure where exactly I am assigning values in my code that would result in this error. I believe it is happening when calculation meso scale terrain effects.
Kind Regards,
André
